card.name: Commas in reference author lists
card.fires_on: The comma (or last initials) right after an author's name inside a long list of authors in a citation or reference list, before the next author's name.

modes.label: Comma after author
modes.description: The comma separating one author from the next in a reference list of names.
modes.example: Nicholas H. Varvel, Stefan A. Grathwohl, Frank Baumann, Christian Liebig<<,>> Andrea Bosch, Bianca Brawek

modes.label: Author initials
modes.description: Initials or a last name piece just before the separating comma in a citation author list.
modes.example: Small KS, Hedman AK, Grunberg E, Nica<< AC>>, Thorleissson G, Kong

card.plain: It marks the spot in a reference list where one author's name ends and the next author's name is about to begin.
